filesystem.description: Access file system for reading/writing prompts, templates, and evaluation results

github.description: Access GitHub for version control and collaboration on prompt repositories

context7.description: Semantic search for finding existing prompts, patterns, and implementations

fetch.description: Fetch data from LLM APIs for testing, evaluation, and production prompt execution

configInfo.purpose: Prompt design, optimization, evaluation, and production prompt system management

github: Review pull requests for prompt updates
fetch: Call LLM APIs for prompt testing

typicalWorkflows.name: Design New Prompt
steps: Use context7 to find similar prompt patterns
Use filesystem to read requirements and examples
Use fetch to test prompt variations with LLM APIs
Use github to version control the final prompt

typicalWorkflows.name: Evaluate Prompt Performance
steps: Use filesystem to load prompt and test sets
Use fetch to execute prompt against LLM APIs
Use filesystem to save evaluation results
Use github to track performance metrics over time

typicalWorkflows.name: Optimize Existing Prompt
steps: Use filesystem to read current prompt
Use context7 to find optimization techniques
Use fetch to test optimized variations
Use filesystem to save token usage comparisons

typicalWorkflows.name: A/B Test Prompts
steps: Use filesystem to load prompt variations
Use fetch to execute parallel tests
Use filesystem to analyze statistical results
Use github to document winning variation
